source:
@@U04677@@
That weird attack of sex ends in a rash,
those blasted flames are now burned out,
and so, as well I should,
I curse you each and every one!

@@U04679@@
He whom the Light of
Creation embraces
Finds in salvation
All of the graces.
Singing great praises,
Rise up to your goal;
The air now is purified,
Breathe now, blest soul!

@@U04680@@
(They rise into the air, bearing 浮士德 ’s immortal part.)

@@U04682@@
(Looking about.)

@@U04683@@
What’s this, what’s this?
Where have they moved off to?
That gang of juveniles caught me off my guard!
And off they fly to heaven with their booty!
That's it, yes, now I know,
that’s why they kept nibbling away at the grave!
I’ve been robbed!
A great, a unique treasure, the noble soul
that pledged itself to me, has been
cunningly filched from under my very nose!
Where to lodge an appeal?
Where to find an ear to bend?
Restore to me what's rightly mine?
Ah, you old goat,
bested in your old age!
And you deserved it, too!
A fine pickle you've got yourself in, you have!
Mismanaged disgracefully!
All that waste of energy!
translation:
@@U04677@@
那种奇怪的性攻击最终会导致皮疹，
那些被炸毁的火焰现在已经被烧灭了
所以，我也应该，
我诅咒你们每一个！

@@U04679@@
他的光
创造拥抱
在救赎中寻找
所有的恩典。
歌颂伟大的歌声，
奋力实现你的目标；
现在空气净化了
现在呼吸吧，神圣的灵魂！

@@U04680@@
（他们升到空中，承载着浮士德的不朽部分。）

@@U04682@@
（环视四周。）

@@U04683@@
这是什么，这是什么？
他们搬到哪里去了？
那帮少年让我措手不及！
然后他们带着战利品飞向天堂！
就是这样，是的，现在我知道了，
这就是为什么他们不断地蚕食坟墓！
我被抢了！
伟大的、独特的宝藏、高贵的灵魂
向我承诺的，已经
狡猾地从我眼皮子底下偷走了！
到哪里提出上诉？
哪里可以找到可以弯曲的耳朵？
把本来属于我的东西还给我？
啊，你这个老山羊，
打败你的晚年！
而你也是应得的！
你已经把自己放进了一个很好的泡菜里，你有！
管理不善可耻！
所有这些都是浪费能源！
